```{r}
#| label: setup-panel
#| include: false
# The fits of the panel-data module that the slides quote, refitted with the
# calls of companion/panel-data.qmd on the committed panel. Comes after the
# setup chunk of the case, whose curve and display files (spec_curve,
# disp_inference, bw_cosmo, loo_twoway and their helpers) it uses as well.
euframes <- readr::read_csv("../cases/eu-frames/data/EUframes_cy.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
country_means <- readr::read_csv("../cases/eu-frames/data/display_country_means.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Pooled OLS under classical errors and under errors clustered by country
pooled_iid <- fixest::feols(mcosmo ~ unemp, data = euframes, vcov = "iid")
pooled_cl <- fixest::feols(mcosmo ~ unemp, data = euframes, cluster = ~cntry)

# The share of the variance of unemployment and of the cosmopolitan share that
# lies between the 27 country means
between_share <- datawizard::demean(euframes, select = c("unemp", "mcosmo"), by = "cntry") |>
  datawizard::data_summary(unemp = var(unemp_between) / var(unemp),
                           mcosmo = var(mcosmo_between) / var(mcosmo))

# The two designs of fixed effects, and the share of the variation of each
# predictor within countries that is common to all countries in a year
m_twfe <- fixest::feols(mcosmo ~ unemp | cntry + year, data = euframes, vcov = "iid")
m_country <- fixest::feols(mcosmo ~ unemp | cntry, data = euframes, vcov = "iid")
within_country <- datawizard::demean(euframes, select = c("unemp", "growth"), by = "cntry")
year_share <- c(
  unemp  = summary(lm(unemp_within ~ factor(year), data = within_country))$r.squared,
  growth = summary(lm(growth_within ~ factor(year), data = within_country))$r.squared
)

# The residual of each country-year in the two-way fit beside the residual of
# the same country in the year before
resid_lag <- euframes |>
  datawizard::data_modify(e = resid(m_twfe)) |>
  datawizard::data_arrange(c("cntry", "year")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(e_before = dplyr::lag(e), .by = cntry)
rho <- cor(resid_lag$e, resid_lag$e_before, use = "complete.obs")

# Random effects with country effects only, and the Hausman test that sets
# the one-way random-effects fit against the one-way fixed-effects fit
m_re <- plm::plm(mcosmo ~ unemp, data = euframes, index = c("cntry", "year"), model = "random")
re_theta <- plm::ercomp(m_re)$theta[["id"]]
fe_one <- plm::plm(mcosmo ~ unemp, data = euframes, index = c("cntry", "year"),
                   effect = "individual", model = "within")
re_one <- plm::plm(mcosmo ~ unemp, data = euframes, index = c("cntry", "year"),
                   effect = "individual", model = "random")
hausman <- plm::phtest(fe_one, re_one)

# The Mundlak form fitted by least squares: its coefficient on the country
# mean is the difference between the two slopes, tested under CR2 errors
euframes_wb <- datawizard::demean(euframes, select = "unemp", by = "cntry")
m_mundlak <- lm(mcosmo ~ unemp + unemp_between, data = euframes_wb)
mundlak_cr2 <- clubSandwich::coef_test(m_mundlak, vcov = "CR2", cluster = euframes_wb$cntry,
                                       coefs = "unemp_between", test = "Satterthwaite")
```
